content:
anya: Thinking out loud — proposal for a lightweight "API runway" coordinator to orchestrate staged API version migrations. The idea: a short-lived control-plane layer that can intercept requests, optionally rewrite shapes/headers, and emit migration telemetry so product + infra can safely cut over. Thoughts?

raf: Love the metaphor. Is this control-plane only or do you see a sidecar/edge proxy component?

anya: Prefer control-plane-first to avoid shipping new client libs. Controller would instruct edge proxies to apply rules per-tenant. Sidecar could be an opt-in later.

mira: Control-plane is cleaner for Hosted, but Dedicated/private customers will want local control. Config schema must support per-deployment/tenant opt-outs and TTLs.

samir: Agree. Also we should limit runway lifetime by default (e.g., 90d) and track active rewrites so we don't forget. Add a hard expiry and email audit.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: runway-controller v0.1 deployed to staging (cluster: infra-staging) — smoke tests passing :rocket:

anya: Rough config sketch:
```yaml
runway:
  window_days: 30
  fallback: v1
  rewrite_rules:
    - match: "/api/v1/generate"
      to: "/api/v2/generate"
      inject_header: "X-Runway:1"
  telemetry_tags: ["runway", "migration_phase"]
```
This would let us observe before forcing.

raf: Add metrics: `runway.migration.{tenant}.{phase}.requests`, `runway.migration.{tenant}.errors`, and `runway.migration.{tenant}.latency_p90`. We'll gate phase progression on those.

mira: Streaming endpoints complicate rewrites — we need chunk-preserving proxies or a transparent header negotiation to avoid re-chunking SSE/HTTP2. If controller rewrites streaming paths, ensure we preserve framing and backpressure.

samir: Implementation option: a small handshake header `X-Runway-Negotiate` — edge checks header, if absent and rule exists, it can do a minimal proxy upgrade. Risk: adds latency on first request. We should measure.

anya: Proposed phased rollout:
1) Observability only (tag traffic, no rewrite)
2) Pass-through with telemetry (controller logs intended rewrites, no change)
3) Soft rewrite (rewrite for a small percent / opt-in tenants)
4) Force cutover (rewrite for all, with fallback to old path on failure)
Each phase has TTL and an automatic rollback trigger by metric circuit.

raf: :thumbsup: We'll add a `runway.health` circuit that trips on error_rate and latency regressions and auto-pauses the runway for affected tenant/endpoint.

mira: Ops runbook snippets: if `error_rate > 0.5%` for 5m after a phase change, immediately revert to previous phase for that tenant and notify owners. Also escalate to on-call if rollback fails.

samir: Also add log sampling and retention controls for runway telemetry — early days will be noisy. Default to 1% sample for full payloads, 100% of headers/metrics.

anya: Good notes. I think we need hooks to support Dedicated/private: allow customers to opt to run the controller locally or accept a signed ruleset from central control-plane. That keeps security/compliance happy.

mira: For security, all rewrite rules must be signed and have a nonce. Also audit logs emitted to customer-specified sinks for Private deployments.

anya: I'll draft an RFC that includes config schema, metric names, phase state machine, and minimal sidecar API. Ping me if you want to co-author.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: on-call note — runway-controller pager: @mira this week.
